title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387992803556 from paid-chain contractions and a mixed-rank BIT supplier
body:
## Mixed-rank BIT supplier

The two paid-chain contractions in this PR, paired with a 480-factor BIT supplier, give **conditional κ ≥ 0.00387992803556**. This raises the independently replayed finite lower bound in #7835 by **0.00000000000955**. The five inherited premises are `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, and `analytic_recovery`. [Construction and proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/PROOF.md) · [Certified result](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/RESULT.json)

The first paid factor determines the cutoff. Grades 1 through 4 use `10^480` and higher grades use `11^480`. Reordering the same factors gives a concrete paid tuple that takes two calls in one order and one in the other. Compared with #7835, the construction reduces the tensor from 832 factors to 480 and the required log₂ N by 21.8%. The complete application charges 36 BIT calls and 48 rational calls at the original signed prices. The independent replay reproduced the complete rational application and audit byte for byte and checked 54 strict and four functional outer conditions. [Independent review](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/review/REVIEW.md) · [Reproduction commands](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15/research/p104-mixed-rank-supplier/README.md#reproduce)

At commit `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, GitHub's dedicated workflow passed the chart-306 chain and finite application. The shared package planner failed its onboarding-helper test and skipped its replay. The separate mixed-supplier replay and audit are recorded in the independent review above. [Chain workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44688740120/job/136129188933) · [Planner log](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44688740070/job/136129189017)

Please review the first-factor partition and the separate uniform and delayed-cover losses. Credit to Dugongue for #7831, Rohan Arun for #7835, and Ali Romman and the other P104 contributors credited below. Clear1nsight prepared this follow-up with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The enrolled target of 0.003889928046155 remains open.

## Earlier paid-chain result

On the exact #7786 rational word, contract paid slots 94318 and 87 (2 → 304 → 306) to 2 → 306 with causal restoration at nine readers. Then in the adjoint contract slots 94025 and 94019 (304 → 2 → 3) to 304 → 3, restoring all 14 readers. The complete finite application gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00387990740712**, exceeding that round’s target of 0.00387981257853 by 0.00000009482859. The 48-call rational and 36-call binary service and five inherited framework assumptions remain. Independent human review and maintainer selection remain open.

## Source and overlap

#7786 head `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`, word `c447b6d5ba956fbe40834fe3c1bc69af2f225736f1b97ecd84b57bab9dd283cb`, layout `f7de788c4a559282d35a9fce42f841a0e8de5a4015db871e718f9245569b0aa7`. First candidate `320847d42f2655c3cc0fd29fe670ae77277e9c2f377c1c92f33d7df050872f54`; combined candidate `7660985e0b618cdbee13e4190a4c6d5f91fbdf01a8f7a5186fdde8b980c19b48`. Chart-3 #7804 fixed-port exclusion remains valid in its own contract; #7814, #7818 and #7819 cover separate chart-278/288 work. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19763075).

## Validation

The archive preserves both frozen words, exact stock identities and literal delta checks, full bounded-scalar applications and expanded audits. An independently implemented exact review checked all 1,289 outputs and 1,661,521 coefficients in both orientations. The combined application uses the independently admitted binary cap 0.0038799074072; the first replay with the looser producer cap failed the independent audit and is not claimed. The pinned cap wrapper patches one assignment in a temporary copy of the authenticated predecessor qualifier. Exact chronology, scalar conversions, cleanup, complete caller and signed invoice are included. See DOUBLE.md for details and reproduction.

The [earlier exact-head hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44658460073/job/136030433591) passed for the first candidate at `211e4ec20ccad8b9c5d2db6619544bede4e0ebac`. The [dedicated replay for the earlier head `14c74c6a67108f675ac1196a5f2415ead0920e71`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44660042728/job/136035750391) passed fresh source authentication, both exact chain checks, the capped full application and expanded audit. The shared planner status is separately tracked.
